rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable description of a good-quality blastocyst with compact ICM and decent TE, but it repeatedly questions the reported expansion stage and adds uncertain features like focal collapse/irregularity that may not be reliably supported from a single image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, BMI, and lifestyle well, with appropriate emphasis on hydrosalpinx as a key modifier of prognosis.

Overall logic is sound, but there are some inconsistencies: it first hedges heavily on morphology, then gives a fairly confident prognosis; it also raises OHSS and fresh-vs-frozen concerns without supporting cycle data.

Mostly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including support for single embryo transfer and attention to hydrosalpinx/luteal support; minor deviations include speculative concern about lining thickness and overstating some paternal-age implications.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, follow-up, hydrosalpinx evaluation, luteal support, and future cycle review, though some recommendations remain somewhat generic due to missing cycle details.
